comment: win/tty/wintty.c process_menu_window(): a getlin prompt drawn on the top line of a full-screen menu, then a page turn, whose term_clear_screen() (1412) runs erase_tty_screen() (2036-2055) over the message, map and status windows. 'O' opens the options menu, which fills two pages. Segment 0: ':' asks "Search for:" (MENU_SEARCH, 1700-1731) on page 1 and again on page 2, each answer ended by Return, with page turns after them. Escape leaves the menu and 'i' shows the status and map redrawn. Segment 1 is the variation: the search is cancelled with Escape over typed text and again over the empty line, '>' on the last page does nothing, and after the menu ':' looks here. The two spaces dismiss the welcome --More--. Seeds, clocks, character and keys chosen independently.
